questions.text: Walk me through what you own end to end in your current role.
questions.why: Anchors the timeline behind the CV bullets.

questions.text: Tell me about a time a client wanted a number your results did not support.
questions.why: No CV evidence for client communication; the JD values honesty about results.

questions.text: How did the jewellery client react when you said the detector was at chance?
questions.why: The CV reports the finding but not how it was delivered.

questions.text: Describe a deadline you could not move. What did you cut?
questions.why: The JD says the deadline rarely moves.

questions.text: Tell me about feedback on your work you disagreed with.
You took sole ownership of an inherited service. How did you get up to speed?
questions.why: A claim of ownership with little detail.

questions.text: The role is hybrid, three days in Noida. Does that work for you?
What do you want next that you do not have now?
What did you change in your work recently because of something new in the field?
What is your notice period, and what are your expectations?
